name: Constellation Brands

What Constellation Brands says to expect

  • Fiscal 2027: EPS and cash flow targetsUpdates fiscal 2027 reported EPS outlook to $11.85 - $12.55, and reaffirms comparable EPS outlook of $11.20 - $11.90, operating cash flow target of $2.4 - $2.5 billion, and free cash flow target of $1.6 - $1.7 billion
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 6, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
